releaseNotes: Dropify 2.0.1 — Pure 2D Neobrutalist Theme, In-Card 1:1 Video/Music Toggle & Ambient Lighting Glow
Pure 2D Neobrutalist UI: Crisp high-contrast paper cards, bold borders, unblurred offset drop shadows, and buttery 120fps scrolling
1:1 In-Card Video & Music Switching: Seamlessly toggle between album art polaroid and square video stream directly inside the song card via sleek [🎵 Music] and [🎥 Video] pills
Atmospheric Ambient Lighting: Real-time dynamic color extraction radiating subtle breathing glow behind the media card and illuminating karaoke lyrics
SimpMusic Synchronized Lyrics: Word-by-word karaoke sweep, multi-script romanization (Devanagari, Gurmukhi, Kana, Hangul, Cyrillic), and Bluetooth latency offset calibration
AMOLED Matte Dark Mode: Pitch black #000000 true black background for OLED battery efficiency and velvety paper cards
Ultra-Fast Offline Downloads: High-speed chunked worker engine with live notification progress and zero-loss Spotify playlist persistence across updates
Frameless desktop experience with Mica material
System Tray integration with quick controls
Windows Taskbar thumbnail toolbar (Thumbar buttons: Play/Pause, Next, Prev)
Global Media Key support (MediaPlayPause, Next, Prev)
Discord Rich Presence showing current song and live progress
10-band DSP Graphic Equalizer with AutoEq presets
